notes.title: Just In Time For Halloween, Spooky Mystery Whodunit Is Now Live!
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6138946/bfafed816a6a7903571576b1dcf456bb986b04af.png

Put your detective hat on and solve the untimely murder of a famous video game designer.

A fabulously wealthy game designer is found dead outside his castle in rural Vermont, and soon evidence shows that this was not merely a freak accident attributed to local superstition. Now it's up to you to investigate the murder and apprehend the guilty. Play as unlikely partners -- ace sleuth Detective Guy and Cleo, the clue-sniffing dog to explore the castle grounds, search for clues, and question suspects. Can you solve the case?

 Murder mystery whodunit
 Play as a detective and dog crime-solving team
 Explore the area and look for clues
 Interview suspects and make deductions
 Solve the case and apprehend the guilty

“I’m excited to share “Murder Is Game Over” with gamers and mystery fans everywhere. I hope players enjoy the exploration mechanics, spooky atmosphere, and classically-inspired whodunit story,” said Matthew of HitherYon Games. 

Murder Is Game Over is 20% off until November 1. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1940090/Murder_Is_Game_Over

notes.title: Now you can choose the difficulty level!
notes.content:
The choice of difficulty does not affect the damage inflicted or received and the number of opponents, as it would be too banal. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085504/f5d87a68fa0eb26d14443634425101794eb60487.png

From now on, before the start of a new run, the following game modes are available to you:

EASY MODE

 More nanoparticles for killed enemies.
 Implants do not damaged.
 You can take up to five extra lives.
 An extra life completely restores health.
 Medical terminals restore up to five health points.


CLASSIC

 Implant damaged if an extra life is spent.
 You can take up to three extra lives.
 An extra life restores only part of your health.
 Medical terminals restore up to three health points.


CHALLENGE

 The chance of damage to the implant when taking damage.
 You can only take one extra life.
 An extra life restores only part of your health.
 Medical terminals restore up to two health points.
 Ability is not restored if you do not have batteries.


I am also glad to announce that the demo version of Iron Dungeon is coming out very soon!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083910/Iron_Dungeon/

notes.title: Try the new game mode
notes.content:
This update offers you to fight in ten consecutive arenas with a large number of enemies.
There are no shelters here, so you will have to rely only on your weapons, implants and your reaction!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085504/4dd9fb5227be6ce96b926cb4fc6888c87a32b4c3.png

Please note that this mode is only available to experienced fighters, so to open access to it, you will first need to defeat the second boss at least once in the main game.

- Several bugs have also been fixed.
- Increased the hitbox of missiles launched by the player.
- Improved font.


In addition, I started working on a new game.
If you are interested, you can add it to your wish list and subscribe for updates! Details will be a little later.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2083910/Iron_Dungeon/

Even though I've started working on a new game, I'm still planning to release updates for REPLIKATOR!

notes.title: Version 1.0 is available!
notes.content:
Hello, friends!
I am glad to announce that version 1.0 is now available!
This means that the main work is finished and the REPLIKATOR has finally reached a full release.
For nine months in early access, the game has undergone significant changes and has become better thanks to everyone who shared feedback with me!

Some changes in the v. 1.0 update:
- Added secret rooms (look for special buttons on the walls).
- New challenge arenas. (you can get there through a portal that opens under certain conditions)
- Добавлена система дополнительных наград за прохождение уровней.
- The balance has been heavily redesigned.
- Added the final boss.
- The maximum number of implants has been increased to 15.
- Now, after activation of replication, there is a possibility of failure of the implant when receiving damage.
- During boss battles, the implant can also be damaged.
- Redesigned some implants and weapons, including VCG10000.
- Fixed a large number of bugs.
- Small visual improvements.
- Many other changes and improvements.
- Localization into Spanish. In the future, I hope to add other localizations.

The work continues.
I plan to release new updates in the future, including bug fixes, game balance improvements, and possibly adding new content.

notes.title: Update v. 0.983
notes.content:

- Improved performance.
- Changes in some implants.
- CX-1 now has a new name - Bolt.
- Oreo now has a new name - Trigger.
- Bosses also have names.
- Sometimes your ship can be attacked. You will have to destroy all the enemies to advance further.
- Lina's ability has been reworked. Now she's calling a medical drone.
- The Bolt (CX-1) ability has also been reworked. Now he's launching homing missiles.
- The maximum possible invulnerability time of a Soldier has been reduced from 20 to 12 seconds.
- Enemy missiles now deal double damage on direct hit.
- Updated user interface.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085504/206d7518d698ac7365cc14d16e90d07049fd8b4e.png

notes.title: Update v. 0.982
notes.content:
- Challenge arenas. When the station is dark, you can open a portal to the challenge arena. To do this, you need to destroy a sufficient number of enemies in a short time.
- You can now find gold-colored weapons. As a rule, the parameters of golden weapons are better, and it have a unique bonus that is not available to regular weapons.
- Now you can not use the shock wave while shooting.
- New enemy turrets.
- When using workbenches, the bonus effect of weapons will be replaced.
- Found item that improves the characteristics of a weapon NO replaces the bonus effect of the weapon.
- The limits for upgrading weapons with workbenches have been reduced, but you can still upgrade weapons with the items you find.
- By destroying the container with nanoparticles, there is a chance to get a battery.
- After the tenth rebirth, enemies stop generating items and nanoparticles.
- Small changes in the work of some implants and weapon bonuses.
- View mode does not work during boss battles.
- Now the full screen mode setting works correctly.
- Fix other bugs.
- Minor visual improvements.

notes.title: Update v. 0.981
notes.content:

notes.title: Update v. 0.98
notes.content:
- Now you can choose one of two modes in the main hub: ROGUELITE or TACTICS.
In the ROGUELITE mode, the descriptions of the implants are not visible until you pick them up (before that, only their titles are visible).
In TACTICS mode, everything is the same as before - the descriptions of the implants are always visible.
- The titles of some implants have been changed.
- Now the destruction of the items may be useful and justified.
- Some dialogues have been rewritten.
- Fixed a bug where implants were repaired even with insufficient nanoparticles.
- Fixed a bug where weapons were not improved using the workbench.
- Other minor fixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40085504/db4902732dec77e70d0a5142917c24b56a2fd00b.jpg

See you in the New Year!

notes.title: Update v. 0.979
notes.content:
- Added the ability to destroy objects with melee attacks (weapons, implants, etc.).
- With the maximum health indicator, there is a small chance of getting a special aid kit. Such a aid kit replenishes the level of health above the maximum value.
- Implants "ADDITIONAL BATTERY", "UNIVERSAL KEY CARD", "FULL MAGAZINE" are now working again.
- Fixed a bug with an increasing price VCG10000.
- Now, when you die, you lose ammunition for VCG 10000.

notes.title: Update v. 0.978
notes.content:
I think some of you have noticed that no new updates have been released recently. The fact is that working on the game takes a lot of time and effort, so I took a little vacation.
Now that I've had some rest, I'm going back to developing.

This small update mainly includes bug fixes and performance improvements on weak computers.

- Fixed incorrect display of markers on the map.
- Now, when you run the game on a laptop, a discrete video adapter is selected. (IAnyway I hope so)*
- Performance optimization.
- Buying a level map now requires one battery instead of two.


*If the game slows down on a laptop with a discrete video card, then you need to go to the video card settings and manually set the game to start using a discrete video adapter.
(Nvidia Control Panel or Catalyst Control Center)

notes.title: Update v. 0.977
notes.content:
UPD!
Now the implants fail only when you lose an extra life (1UP).
The cost of an extra life is slightly reduced. 
Now you can buy up to three 1UP, or find up to five 1UP at stations.

[strike]Now, when you take damage, one of your implants may fail.[/strike]

FAULTY implants have negative consequences, as a rule - the opposite of the positive effect of SERVICEABLE implants.

On the ship you will find a workbench where you can repair all the implants.

Among other changes:

- Small graphic changes.
- Small changes in the balance.

notes.title: REPLIKATOR is Now Available to Play!
notes.content:
REPLIKATOR is a fast Top Down Shooter with roguelike elements, inspired by the games Nuclear Throne and Dead Cells.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1576370/extras/short_11.08__online-video-cutter.com_.gif?t=1628766414

Why Early Access
The experience of publishing demo versions has shown how useful feedback from interested players is. Since the publication of the first demo version, the game has been transformed by an order of magnitude!
I don't know how it happens in big studios, but when you work on a game alone, you just miss a lot of things or deliberately ignore them. Players notice all these nuances and point them out.
And now the moment has come when the demo versions are not enough to get adequate feedback.
Thanks to early access, I want to perfect the balance, add even more content and game situations, and of course, complete the story.

What is ready at the moment
- More than 30 different enemies.
- More than 30 types of weapons with generated characteristics
- More than 70 implants.
- More than 20 generated levels.
- 4 bosses.
- The system of increasing the difficulty after successful runs (5 iterations of difficulty).

In fact, this is a completely ready-made game with a considerable amount of content, in which it is quite possible to spend several tens of hours.
But I do not intend to stop there! Therefore, the game will be expanded and improved in every possible way!
I sincerely hope that you will like the game and you will help me make it better!

If you have previously played the demo version, then I recommend starting a new game for a better gaming experience! :)

Join our Discord server!
